name: Early pottery at Xianrendong Cave
description: Mobile foragers associated with Xianrendong Cave left fired ceramic vessel fragments, indicating container-making before local agriculture. Cooking is possible but not established by the cited abstract.

date.label: 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP
date.basis: Source dates archaeological contexts in calibrated years before present; 1950 is the BP reference.

events.statement: The earliest pottery-bearing contexts are dated 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP.

evidence.supports: The earliest pottery-bearing contexts are dated 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP.

contributions.group: Mobile foragers associated with Xianrendong Cave

evidence.supports: Authors attribute the early cave pottery to mobile foragers.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest date established for this specific documented case by the sources inspected; it does not establish an invention date or world priority.

caveats: Context dating is not direct dating of manufacture; chronology and claimed priority require continued comparison with newer archaeological work.

research.note: Independent check of the archaeological-context date and forager attribution against the cited 2012 paper; source metadata correctly identifies the original abstract-only reading. Review of other facets remains open.
